## Protocol & Type Safety
#47: Replaces `dict[str, Any]` with typed-dynamic primitives, using `Mapping[str, JsonValue]` for open payloads and `TypedDict` for known structures. Enforces JSON-safety and documents constraints like `max_keys=100` and `max_depth=5`.
#51: Adds `ProtocolHandlerContract` interface for type-safe handler contracts, including behavior descriptors, capability dependencies, and execution constraints.
#69: Codifies `ProtocolEventPublisher` semantics and policy, documenting topic override and partition key semantics. Adds 18 unit tests to prevent interface drift.

## CI & Release Engineering
#307: Adds a `sync_only` input to `release.yml` to retry the idempotent main sync half without re-uploading irreversible publishing artifacts.
#1562: Gates `test-parallel` and `tests-integration` jobs behind non-draft PR state to save runner costs.
#363: Moves CodeQL reusable workflow reference to `omnibase_core` and updates required checks.
#314: Bumps `public-repo-hygiene-reusable.yml` dependency to a newer commit.
#1208: Backmerges main guard into dev promotion lane.
#1252: Bumps `omnibase_core` to v0.45.0 to propagate breaking API deletion signals.
#1713: Adds `call-occ-autobind` caller to `omnibase_core`, resolving a missing evidence companion issue.
#1462: Fixes `no-hardcoded-ip` check to scan multiple roots including `scripts/`.
#1324: Burns down 3 grandfathered URL authority reads in `omniintelligence`.

## Core Model & Logic Fixes
#1717: `occ-preflight` now accepts dependency-pin-only outcomes, preventing false failures on version bumps.
#1655: Fixes def-B single-emit terminal correlation matching to prevent discarding valid terminals.
#1590: Restricts OCC repo matching to exact canonical names to prevent misclassification.
#966: Implements Gate 4 for banned silent `except` blocks in the substrate gates framework.
#1255: Adds UI contract primitives and `EnumEmptyStateReason` for the Contract-Driven UI Platform.

## Market Node & Orchestration
#3413: Sends completed delegations to the acceptance judge and moves request models to `omnimarket.models`.
#3274: Corrects savings file shape and regenerates relation inventory to fix test failures.
#3635: Registers `node_morning_ground_state_orchestrator` entry point in `pyproject.toml`.
#3655: Moves shard-plan partition proof to typecheck job to reduce integration-guard duration.
#3051: Projects lane container memory events into `lab_container_memory_window`.
#3466: Moves real redelivery tests into the Golden Chain Suite.
#3710: Implements M4 landing configs from facts and idempotent enqueue logic.
#2955: Routes `hook.event` in emit registry and governs nested members by dotted name.
#3289: Mirrors dispatched credential path in routing reducer eligibility checks.
#3805: Adds automation-liveness watchdog compute for verdicts and failure episodes.
#3161: Carries `caller_lane` and `session_id` on delegate-skill terminals.
#2841: Declares `no_escalation` on delegate-skill requests, passing it only when true.

## Documentation & Branding
#279: Adds official OmniNode brand `<picture>` README header with color-scheme support.
